text:
If your Friday plans can handle a stray shower and a cooler breeze, you’re in good shape, but keep a light jacket nearby. Today brings a mix of sun and clouds with isolated showers, more likely to pop up this afternoon, and a high right around 59. West winds will run 7 to 12 mph, with gusts up to 25, so it’ll feel brisk by the waterfront. On the broad lake, waves build from 1 to 2 feet toward 2 to 3 feet, making it a better day for a short outing than a long sail.

Tonight dries out quickly, with skies clearing and temperatures falling to around 40. Saturday is the payoff, full sun, lighter wind, and a high near 57, with calmer waves around 1 to 2 feet. Looking ahead, Sunday is the less certain day: a wetter pattern may arrive Sunday night and linger into Monday morning. Enjoy the lake or a long walk Saturday, and be off the water before today’s afternoon wind and showers pick up.
